params.prompt: Original pixel-art decorative background plate for a classic 2D arcade fighting-game character selection interface. No text, numbers, logo, portraits, characters, buttons, cards or user-interface controls. A blackened gunmetal surface, fine angular engraved geometric filigree and symmetrical chamfered frame lines near the perimeter; saturated scarlet-red light from the left, cobalt-blue light from the right, thin golden-yellow highlights. Dark quiet center and lower two-thirds so live fighter previews and a dense portrait grid can be placed above it. Subtle diagonal mechanical texture, stepped pixel clusters, high-quality 1990s/early-2000s arcade pixel aesthetic, crisp edges, flat orthographic view. Use only charcoal-black neutrals with red, blue and yellow accent hues. Ornamental empty border rather than a complete screenshot. Keep all decoration within outer ten percent; very low-contrast central texture. 16:9.
